title: Zoning text change for open space in Staten Island's South Richmond district
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment adjusting Designated Open Space boundaries within the Special South Richmond Development District in the Prince's Bay and Arden Heights neighborhoods of Staten Island, Community District 3. It also updates outdated and contradictory zoning text to align with the earlier South Richmond Zoning Relief amendment. The City Planning Commission found the change would not cause new environmental impacts beyond those already studied in a 2023 environmental review.​
